name: ChurchLinker
shortDescription: A UK-built church management platform with people records, rotas, giving, Gift Aid reports, communications, sermons and a member app.
suitableContexts: UK churches that want a single members-and-ministry platform
Church plants and small churches seeking a no-card free plan

pricing.summary: ChurchLinker publishes GBP contact-band prices, a permanent free plan up to 50 contacts and a 14-day trial for paid plans. Verify the live scope of new-product features and add-ons before relying on them.

tiers.label: Seed
tiers.detail: Up to 50 contacts; supplier says it does not expire

pricing.trialDetails: The supplier advertises a 14-day paid-plan trial without a card, alongside its permanent free Seed plan.

dataHosting: The supplier states that data is held in UK/EU data centres.
gdprInformation: The supplier publishes GDPR, sub-processor and data-processing agreement links.
coreFeatures: Giving via a church Stripe account
importExport: Supplier describes CSV imports from ChurchSuite, Breeze, Planning Center and Elvanto
support: Supplier says support is direct from its UK team

editorial.assessment: ChurchLinker is a compelling UK-first option on published price and feature coverage, especially for smaller churches. It appears to be an early product, so a buyer should validate the maturity of the exact workflows, service levels, data processing and migration support it needs before switching live records.
bestFor: Small and growing UK churches that want GBP pricing and native Gift Aid tools
Teams happy to run a controlled trial of a newer supplier
strengths: Permanent free plan and published GBP tiers
Supplier describes built-in Gift Aid, GASDS and UK/EU data hosting
limitations: Newer product with feature maturity requiring practical validation
Churches must separately verify Stripe fees, contractual terms and data-processing suitability

procurementVerdict.problem: Small and growing UK churches that want GBP pricing and native Gift Aid tools
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Newer product with feature maturity requiring practical validation

longForm.verdict: ChurchLinker is an interesting UK-first alternative for churches that want people, rotas, giving and member communications to share one system. Its free plan makes a controlled workflow test feasible, but its newer-market position makes due diligence more important, not less.

decisionLens.heading: Test the weekly hand-off, not the feature list.
decisionLens.text: The supplier presents a wide connected workflow, including volunteer rotas, visitor follow-up, Gift Aid reports and communications. Ask the actual admin, treasurer and rota lead to complete their ordinary week in a test space, then assess support, reporting accuracy and migration before importing live data.

sections.heading: UK-first claims need operational confirmation
sections.question: Can the product support the church’s real financial and safeguarding controls?
paragraphs: ChurchLinker says its paid plans include Gift Aid and GASDS reports, that donations route through the church’s own Stripe account, and that it uses UK/EU data centres. It also describes DBS tracking and reminders.

These are useful starting points, not a substitute for checking the church’s Gift Aid records, privacy documentation, access roles and safeguarding procedures. Arrange a supplier walkthrough using the church’s actual use cases before any live migration.

userFeedback.summary: This profile does not give an independent review score. It is based on ChurchLinker’s published pricing, privacy statements and feature descriptions.
themes: The free tier lowers the barrier to a realistic team trial.
The key risk is validating maturity and support for the workflows the church cannot afford to disrupt.
userFeedback.caveat: Supplier claims about UK fit, data hosting and functionality have not been independently tested by this directory.

faq.question: Does ChurchLinker have a free plan?
faq.answer: Yes. The supplier advertises its Seed plan as free for up to 50 contacts, with no card and no expiry.

faq.question: Does ChurchLinker offer a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. ChurchLinker advertises a 14-day trial for paid plans.

faq.question: How much does ChurchLinker cost?
faq.answer: Published paid tiers run from £19 to £129 per month by contact band. The supplier also lists a £79-per-month own-app add-on. Check current add-ons and VAT directly.

faq.question: Does ChurchLinker support Gift Aid?
faq.answer: Yes, according to the supplier. It describes built-in Gift Aid and GASDS reports. The church should still verify its own HMRC, declaration and reconciliation workflow.
